_comment: THE INCLUDE LIST, and the source of truth for what this page loads.
The page fetches exactly this -- no candidate list, no directory scan -- so
adding a provider to the browser runtime is an edit here and nothing else.
WindowProvider first: it is the one this page exists for, and load order is
ShellProvider second so the navigator still comes up in the embedded
terminal -- drop it and the canvas still works, with nothing to type at.
NAMES, NOT PATHS. These are fetched from the SHARED artifact directory --
/wasm/, which is bin/wasm/ mounted by serve_web.etcs -- and staged into
MEMFS under the bare name, because preload_web_modules dlopens by name and
run_script opens by name. The url and the staged name are different things.
Optional "base": pin that directory and the page skips its own
same-origin-then-beside-then-remote walk. See resolveWasmBase in index.html.
_scripts: Staged into the browser's MEMFS by the page, by these names, before main()
runs -- so each name here must answer over HTTP. boot.etcs is in www/;
every pump script is MOUNTED at its name from its real location elsewhere
in the tree (../serve_web.etcs), so nothing is duplicated to be servable
and no directory above the served tree is exposed.
A NAME MAY BE A PATH. render_frames.etcs is staged at the same relative
path paint_surface.etcs reads it from on the OS side, so the `detach` line
in boot_paint.etcs is spelled once for both substrates rather than twice.
_glue: The emscripten loader output, STAGED AS .js: served extensionless it arrives
as application/octet-stream, which the browser warns is not a valid
